title: Dragon Fire Anagama Firing – April 2027
source_quote:
April 2027
Loading April 2 & 3
Firing April 4-9
Unloading April 18
evidence_sentence: The anagama firing schedule lists a second firing April 4–9, 2027, with the same work-shift structure.
evidence_quote: This Japanese-style cave kiln is fueled by wood and holds hundreds of pots.
summary: A second community wood-firing of the Dragon Fire Anagama kiln April 4–9, 2027. Earn kiln space by working shifts with the same point system and fees. Bring bisque-fired Cone 10 pieces; participants glaze and wad their own work.
commitment: Fri-Sat load · Sun-Fri stoking shifts · Apr 18 unload
bring: Bisque-fired Cone 10 pottery, work gloves, protective clothing
cost_text: $25 per point (optional purchase for kiln space)
how_to_join: Contact the Art Center at 859-236-4054 or email admin@artcenterky.org to be added to the email list for firing dates and sign-up opening.
